name: Good Advice
description: Lets the agent weave one saved line from the Agentic Journal "Good advice" bookmarks folder into a reply: when it fits the conversation, or once a day unprompted.

journalUrl.description: Agentic Journal base URL. Default http://127.0.0.1:3000.

folderName.description: Bookmark folder to draw advice from. Default "Good advice".

matchThreshold.description: Trigger score a card needs to count as matching the current message. Default 2.5.

maxMatchedPerDay.description: Matched advice allowed per day across all conversations. Default 3.

maxDailyOffers.description: Times per day the unprompted remark is offered before giving up. Default 3; 0 turns it off.

cooldownDays.description: Days before a used quote may come back. Default 30.
